## Problem

What are you trying to fix or improve? Link a related issue when useful.

## Change

Describe the resulting behavior. Mention effects on stored data, permissions,
public output, external requests or operating costs.

## Checks

List completed commands and manual checks with results. State what you could
not check. For interface changes, include useful screenshots with synthetic
content and note light/dark, narrow-layout and keyboard checks.

## Documentation

Link updated guidance or explain why no update is needed. Include upgrade or
recovery instructions when existing installations are affected.

## Contributor agreement

- [ ] I have read [the Shipit SEO Contributor Agreement, version 1](https://github.com/logelog/shipit-seo-plugin/blob/main/CLA.md) and have permission to submit this contribution under its terms.

Each contributor must also post this acceptance in a pull request comment:

> I agree to the Shipit SEO Contributor Agreement, version 1.

The checkbox does not verify a signature or replace that acceptance. The
maintainer records the accepted version and agreement revision before merging.
Do not attach identity documents, personal addresses or signature images.
